cruise_line_or_employer: Crew Life at Sea (recruitment agency, river cruise placements)
duties_raw: Daily cleaning and servicing of guests' rooms
Daily assistance with the cleaning of all public areas including public toilets, fitness, lobby and reception areas
The correct distribution of daily programs, gift orders and correct turndown service in the assigned rooms
Achieving and maintaining the company's standards in the housekeeping department
Correct handling of guests' laundry
Correct handling and storage of all housekeeping supplies, detergents and equipment
Assisting in taking inventory of the housekeeping department
requirements_raw: Cabin Steward promotes a positive image to guests and must be pleasant, honest, friendly and should also able to address guest requests and problems.
You should maintain complete knowledge of and comply with all housekeeping departmental policies/service, procedures/standards.
maintain complete knowledge of correct maintenance and use of equipment

duties_raw: Clean and service assigned staterooms daily, including bathrooms, balconies, and living areas.
Replenish amenities and supplies such as towels, toiletries, and minibar items.
Make beds and change linens as required.
Ensure rooms meet company cleanliness and presentation standards before guest arrival and during their stay.
Respond promptly and professionally to guest requests, preferences, and feedback.
Report maintenance issues or damage in staterooms to the appropriate department.
Assist with embarkation and disembarkation processes as assigned.
Maintain cleaning equipment and supplies in good working condition.
Follow all safety, sanitation, and hygiene procedures in accordance with onboard policies.
requirements_raw: Minimum 12 years of housekeeping experience in a hotel, resort, or hospitality setting.
Cruise ship experience is advantageous but not required.
Previous experience with luxury service standards is a plus.
Strong attention to detail and cleanliness.
Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Physical stamina and ability to lift, bend, and stand for extended periods.
Discretion and respect for guest privacy.
Fluency in Spanish or other European languages (e.g., Italian, French, German, Portuguese) is highly preferred.
High school diploma or equivalent required.
Housekeeping or hospitality training is preferred.
STCW and ENG1 (or cruise line-specific equivalents) required before embarkation.
experience_years_required: Minimum 12 years of housekeeping experience in a hotel, resort, or hospitality setting.
language_requirements: Fluency in Spanish or other European languages (e.g., Italian, French, German, Portuguese) is highly preferred.
physical_requirements: Physical stamina and ability to lift, bend, and stand for extended periods.

cruise_line_or_employer: Esalen Institute (NOTE: land-based wellness retreat, not a cruise line — included only because the exact title variant 'Housekeeping Steward' was requested)
duties_raw: Clean and maintain the seminarian rooms and meeting rooms
Clean and maintain assigned public areas and the baths
Work cooperatively with team and communicate kindly
Process laundry and stock inventory
Assist in the training and orientation of new stewards
Be a team liaison to other Departments such as the Office, the Gate, Healing Arts, Programs, and Maintenance
Reliable and timely attendance – this position works on-site
Maintain and inspect equipment
Move furniture when required
Support the Lodging Experience Manager and Lead(s) with any operational needs
requirements_raw: Adapt to a new work environment socially and physically. Integrate emotional work while meeting demands of your weekly work schedule.

Handle physical labor involving lifting, bending, being on feet for long periods of time, and maintain repetitive motions. Carrying heavy objects; loading/unloading bundles and equipment, loading/unloading industrial washing equipment, and stocking boxes of inventory.
Ability to be detail oriented and organized.
Ability to work under pressure while meeting deadlines.
Ability to handle a variety of cleaning products.
Communicate well with others and be open to meeting new people at work.
Prior work experience at Esalen is preferred.
physical_requirements: the employee must be able to work in a physically demanding environment; maneuver on uneven ground; stand for long periods of time; regularly lift and carry bags and bundles up to 30 pounds; carry, push and pull vacuums; lift, bend, carry, load and unload laundry in and out of industrial washing equipment; move furniture. There is daily exposure to biodegradable chemicals.
salary_or_contract_info: $18.50 - $21.00 an hour - Full-time. Housing available on-site (residential fee charged). All meals provided.

cruise_line_or_employer: Belmond (Britannic Explorer, a Belmond Train — NOTE: luxury train, not a cruise ship, but same title variant and directly overlapping cabin-cleaning duties)
duties_raw: Providing excellent customer service to guests in accordance with Belmond and Leading Quality Assurance standards.
Cleaning guest cabins and public areas according to departmental standards.
Making guest beds with clean linen, replacing and adding guest amenities and collateral, and reporting any maintenance defects in the cabins and corridors.
Assisting with general onboard duties, including greeting guests, helping with luggage and supporting other operational departments as required.
Maintaining both team, personal, customer and non-customer facing areas to the highest standards and always presenting yourself immaculately.
requirements_raw: Applicants must have eligibility to work in the UK.
1-2 years' relevant experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality industry.
Hospitality qualification an advantage.
COSHH knowledge and awareness.
Knowledge of housekeeping operations, including cleaning practices, hygiene, safety & security, chemicals, cleaning equipment, bed-making, arranging guest supplies, etc.
Ability to work in high-pressure situations, to follow instructions and work independently when required.
experience_years_required: 1-2 years' relevant experience in a similar role, preferably within the luxury hospitality industry.

cruise_line_or_employer: LandSea (NOTE: ski resort in Squamish, BC — not a cruise line; tangential match on job title only, included for completeness/transparency)
duties_raw: Sweep, mop, wash and polish floors
Dust furniture
Vacuum carpeting, area rugs, draperies and upholstered furniture
Make beds and change sheets
Distribute clean towels and toiletries
Stock linen closet
Clean, disinfect and polish kitchen and bathroom fixtures and appliances
Handle and report lost and found items
Attend to guests' requests for extra supplies or other items
Provide basic information on facilities
Pick up debris and empty trash containers
Perform light housekeeping and cleaning duties
Clean changing rooms and showers
requirements_raw: Secondary (high) school graduation certificate or equivalent experience
2 years to less than 3 years experience
English language
required_certs: Workplace Hazardous Materials Information System (WHMIS) Certificate
physical_requirements: Weight handling up to 23 kg (50 lbs)
salary_or_contract_info: Staff accommodation provided. Room and board provided.

source_site: ACL Careers (American Cruise Lines official careers site)
duties_raw: Responsible for creating and maintaining an environment that is clean, safe, and attractive for our guests.
Prioritizing comfort and cleanliness of staterooms, facilities, and common areas around the ship.
Acknowledge guests by name and kindly take action for all housekeeping-related inquiries and service requests according to American Cruise Lines' service standards.
Vacuuming, sweeping, and mopping floors.
Organizing inventory and stocking linen and supplies.
Carefully cleaning up spills with appropriate equipment and notifying managers of necessary maintenance requests.
Collecting and disposing of trash.
Properly cleaning upholstered furniture and lounge spaces.
Creating genuine relationships with our guests and catering to all housekeeping requests in an efficient manner.

In addition to the routine housekeeping duties, Housekeepers may be required to perform other functions, such as greeting guests upon embarkation, and helping during special events including but not limited to afternoon tea and snacks and participate in evening cocktail parties.
requirements_raw: You must be at least eighteen (18) years of age and an American citizen or Green Card holder.
You must be able to perform the essential functions of the job with or without accommodation.
Under Federal Law and the Department of Transportation, we are required to pre-employment drug test all shipboard employees which includes testing for Marijuana and other controlled substances.
the consumption of alcohol is strictly prohibited
All shipboard employees also have emergency and safety functions essential to the safe operation of the ship that are included in your training.
American Cruise Lines has grooming standards that include limitations on visible tattoos and piercings.
This is a temporary employment position not to extend beyond 28 weeks of shipboard work.
physical_requirements: Ships experience forces from wind, waves, and currents, prompting them to exhibit six distinct motions known as ship motions. The six motions are surge, sway, heave, roll, pitch, and yaw. This position requires the ability to live and satisfactorily perform job duties in an environment that is subject to constant motion.
Ability to work around 12 hours per day.
Ability to assist in the event of an on-board emergency by quickly climbing up a ladder, opening, and passing through a 20” diameter hatch.
Ability to stand for your entire shift.
Ability to frequently lift up to 20 lbs. and occasionally lift up to 50 lbs.
Ability to frequently bend, squat and reach.
Ability to live and work on board a vessel for extended periods of time.
salary_or_contract_info: Wages range from $1,000 to $1,400 per week with additional bonuses. With all major living expenses covered aboard (travel, room and board, uniforms, and training).
contract_length: Up to 28 weeks, 7 days per week while onboard; full-time, nonexempt, temporary position with no guarantee of future employment
